narration.text: I tested 20 AI tools for podcasters, and only five are worth your time.
At number five, it's CapCut. This free tool offers brilliant video editing, automatic captions, and even some basic audio clean-up. It is perfect for visualising your podcast.
Coming in at number four, we have Podcastle. It removes background noise instantly and improves vocal clarity. Your listeners will notice the difference in sound quality.
Number three is Opus Clip. This tool transforms your long podcast episodes into engaging short video clips, ready for social media. It saves so much editing time.
In second place, it's Descript. Imagine editing your audio simply by editing text. Descript is incredibly powerful and intuitive, making complex edits surprisingly simple.
And the top spot goes to Riverside.fm! It offers studio-quality recordings for remote interviews and even generates AI show notes. This tool is a game-changer for serious podcasters.
Riverside.fm truly stands out for its comprehensive features. Did your favourite make the cut? Tell me in the comments!
